先分清两个名字。Medicare 是联邦医保，通常与 65 岁或特定资格有关；M: Start with the two names. Medicare is federal health insurance, generally linked to age 65 or specific eligibility. Medi-Cal is California's Medicaid program, offering free or low-cost coverage to people who qualify. These are separate programs; age, income or immigration status alone cannot establish eligibility.
第一步：预约免费咨询，不急着选保险产品: Step 1: book free counseling before choosing a plan

多数人首次报名窗口从 65 岁生日所在月前三个月开始，到生日月后三个月结束。仍在: For most people, the initial enrollment period starts three months before the month they turn 65 and ends three months afterward. Employment, a spouse's employer coverage, COBRA or existing Medi-Cal can change the next steps. Check your dates using Medicare's official questions and HICAP to avoid coverage gaps or late-enrollment penalties.
